title: Bookmarks file
description: Per-book bookmarks, written by BookmarkFile (src/util/BookmarkFile.cpp) to /.crosspoint/bookmarks/<name>.json, where <name> is the book path without its leading slash and extension, with '/' and '\' replaced by '_'.

summary.description: First words of the bookmarked page, whitespace-collapsed and truncated to 72 bytes.

name.description: Optional user label, at most 128 bytes (longer names are truncated on load and rejected on save). Omitted when empty.

si.description: Spine index at the time of bookmarking.

pc.description: Page count of the chapter at the time of bookmarking.

pp.description: Page index within the chapter at the time of bookmarking.

vo.description: Visible-codepoint offset of the page within its spine item; unaffected by re-pagination. Absent on bookmarks created before it existed.
